strings: r_c0 worriedly fusses over m_c in the medicine den. It appears that after {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} last couple of seizures, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} left weak and at risk of fainting.
m_c finds {PRONOUN/m_c/self} on the ground, staring at the sky with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates worriedly checking on {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
Seizures aren't the only thing sending m_c to collapse.
